facts.fact: 她用铸铁锅砸中对方的脸，人被烫又被重击，仰面倒地
facts.anchor: wrench the cast-iron pan off the stove

facts.fact: 她抓起切肉叉刺进他胸口，重复至少半打次
facts.anchor: I grabbed the carving fork and sunk it into his chest

facts.fact: 叙述者承认这一连串动作并不难，与「本该很难」的预期相反
facts.anchor: I promised I would always be honest with you

facts.fact: 她确认人已经死透，不会像电影里那样再爬起来
facts.anchor: He was dead. He wasn’t coming back.

facts.fact: 门铃响后 Kay 站在门口，先问她是否身处危险
她说卧室里有一杯掺着杀死 Deirdre 那种芬太尼的鸡尾酒，让 Kay 取样送检
facts.anchor: the same fentanyl that killed Deirdre

facts.fact: 她手机里积了约一千通 Kay 的未接来电
facts.anchor: approximately one thousand missed calls from Kay Adams

facts.fact: Kay 说那根绳子只可能是用法的人离开庄园后再没回来
facts.anchor: the only way it would still be hanging there like that

facts.fact: Kay 的姐姐用碱性水解，六到八小时后只剩液体和骨渣
facts.anchor: Six to eight hours later, hey presto, all you’ve got is soup.

facts.fact: Kay 在路边抱住她，说她已经算家人
facts.anchor: I want you to know you’re family now
